name: deepsuck
description: 开源 AI 反诈“拖住”机器人：拖延骗子时间并提取脱敏诈骗情报。

scripts.build:intel: cd python && python3 -m deepsuck.stix ../site/data/intel.json -o ../site/data/intel.stix.json && python3 -m deepsuck.feeds ../site/data/intel.json --out-dir ../site/data
scripts.blog:preview: node scripts/build-blog.js --drafts --out .blog-preview && echo "预览：cd .blog-preview && python3 -m http.server 8081 → http://localhost:8081/blog/"
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently@9 -n proxy,voice -c gray,yellow "node server/index.js" "python3 -m voice.app"
